disposition_records.T16-REDUCTION-NAN-CONTRACT: 47 NaN-dropping sites across 23 functions (19 public) plus element-wise min/max and clip/clamped now propagate NaN (S1 zero sign unspecified; Z1 maximumMagnitude +0; E1 empty → −∞/+∞/0, now library-defined via explicit count guards; I1 SIMDStorage.minMax starts from ±∞; index APIs give the first NaN). RED (independent pre-fix probe: 73/107 rows, 36,575 cells) → GREEN 0 in Debug and Release. NaN-free outputs: 259,408/259,786 bit-identical; the other 378 are exactly E1/I1/Z1.
disposition_records.T16-PROVIDER-DISAGREEMENT: The Swift providers kept NaN only at element 0, while vDSP kept it except in the scalar tail and n≤3 (all-NaN gave ∓∞); they disagreed on 207-251 of 411 fixtures. Explicit in-source NaN scans now define the contract on both; Accelerate clip relies on the DOCUMENTED vDSP_vclip formula (one host; Intel unverified).
disposition_records.T16-REDUCTION-CLASS-CLOSURE: T16ReductionRegistry plus T16ReductionExceptionalTableTests (every reduction × provider, NaN at every index, 18 sizes, Swift/Accelerate agreement); test_reduction_nan_guard.py (F1-F7 including accumulator-either-side, argmin with assignment anywhere, max(by:) trailing closure, fmax/fmin, pointwiseMax/Min, leading-dot chains, parenthesised and negated conditions; the Int filter (RD14); tabled/external/exempt registry with reasons; LIMITS).

limitations: Performance (one loaded host, disclosed): the Swift reductions +6-10%, Accelerate 2.1-2.7× for n≥1536, element-wise min 1.4×.
The Accelerate clip NaN behaviour rests on the documented vDSP_vclip formula, verified on one host only.
The guard is lexical (LIMITS: += and ternary updates, helper or inout folds, guard-style folds, let/case pattern conditions).
Profiler rows run only in ChildProbeLauncher children (not under ASan).
